description: Protocol governance contract for Stage 4-A through 4-D. This file defines required protocol fields, naming rules, priority bands, expansion targets, and fixed priority competition cases.

bands.name: critical_immediate
bands.description: Immediate physical danger that may preempt all other protocols.

bands.name: high_risk_support
bands.description: High-risk but usually non-preemptive support protocols.

bands.name: medium_support
bands.description: Psychological, de-escalation, or lower urgency support.

bands.name: fallback
bands.description: Noise, unclear input, and fallback guidance.
